title: ANF coefficients of an affine function
statement: For $b\in\mathbb F_2$ and $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the coefficient function of $x\mapsto b+a\cdot x$ has value $b$ on the empty set, value $\sum_{i\in S}a_i$ on each singleton set $S$, and value $0$ on every other set of coordinates.
